A. Reverse #465, a box on Home (owner ruling; before any PR). Recommendation: yes, a real box in the Home hero between the line and the three options; the header box stays hidden on Home.

C. Phase 1 answer kinds (ruling; before PR 1). Recommendation: programs, filtered lists, conferences, ID camps and current head coaches. Players and commits stay out (mostly minors). Assistant and former coaches, clubs, high schools and 'near <city>' wait for phase 2.
D. Player names in the judged set (ruling; before PR 1). Recommendation: drop R01-R05 while players are out of scope.

I. Conference aliases (ruling; before PR 1, the table ships in PR 2). Recommendation: a reviewed table that keeps each entry's evidence as text (quote, URL, date checked), checked in CI when an entry is added and skipped with a warning if it goes stale. Phase 1 ships B1G, CCAA, NESCAC and UAA.

L. Phase 1 fact words (ruling; before PR 1). Recommendation: division, conference, state, region (New England = Northeast); 'small' = under 5,000 undergraduates; 'under 30k' = the page's Tuition condition; 'warm' = fall average high above 80F; top N RPI. Colour, snow, religion, public/private and majors are named back as not applied.

M. Collisions, conference rows and 'too broad' (ruling; before PR 1). Recommendation: D1 before D2 before D3 among ties. A fact leads unless the query is exactly a displayed name. A state name after 'university of' or 'college of' is part of a name. Conference rows from words need whole words (a last word of 4+ letters may be a prefix), shared words in the name, and no lone 1-2 letter word. One word-based too-broad rule that shows Programs only. 'LA' alias optional. A separate issue reviews the build's initials rule.
S. Cities (ruling; before PR 1). Recommendation: a city finds and labels program rows; there is no city list row and no city= parameter.
U. 'UMass Boston' alias (ruling; before PR 1). Recommendation: a cited registry alias in its own issue outside #507; Y07 is 'phase 2' until a fixture refresh includes it.
C01-C19, the draft's decisions (statuses; before PR 1). Recommendation: approve the status table in section 9 (C01 superseded by sections 5.2 and 5.3; C13 withdrawn; the rest decided under A-U).
N. Test clock (team default; before PR 1): frozen at 2026-10-20T16:09:38Z, America/Los_Angeles.
P. Process (team default; before PR 1): one sub-issue per PR, each saying Closes the sub-issue and Part of #507.

T. Shared words and twins (team default; before PR 1, used from PR 3): the fixed list in section 4.1, optional in program rows and required in conference rows. On a State-side program, 'St.' and a build-made 'Saint' are read as State. A separate issue to fix the build's St./Saint swap is recommended.
E. Search data shape (team default; before PR 2): one self-contained file, about 55 KB at gzip -9, size pinned by a base plus a per-row rate on the fixture.
F. Serving (team default; before PR 2): /api/v1/search, behind the usual session gate and rate limits.
H. state= on the Programs address (ruling; before PR 4). Recommendation: yes, with a State filter on the rail, ANDed with region like every Programs facet.
Q. 'Cold' (ruling; before PR 5). Recommendation: fall average high below 65F (134 programs on 2026-10-20 data); the alternative is to name it back until phase 2.

B. Phone form and label (ruling; before the PR 6 mockup set, so before PR 6a). Recommendation: a hero button that opens a full-screen sheet built on phoneSheet(); the owner picks a visible or screen-reader-only label from the mockup.
G. Loading (team default; before PR 6b): code at idle on Home (at first focus on Save-Data), data at first focus, no requests while typing.

O. Local browser check (team default; before PR 6b): the committed tools/search_browser_check.mjs, run offline with the installed Playwright 1.56.1 and Chromium 141, with its JSON record in each visible PR.
R. Home in #394's measured views (ruling; before PR 6b). Recommendation: yes, as its own small PR after 6d.

K. Ask in the Home box (ruling; before PR 6e). Recommendation: an owner-only last option in its own PR; Shift+Enter always asks, Enter asks only on an empty slate; no option and no request with Ask off.
J. The header box (ruling; after PR 8). Recommendation: coexist in phase 1; decide on measurements after PR 8 whether its suggestions use the same engine, and retire the old matcher only after that.
